tree_state: all listed files are uncommitted at recording time and are committed in the commit that follows this record; the recorded commit is its parent
summary: Vendor reboot-to-download sequence (INFORM2 byte, INFORM3 reason, reboot-cmd mode bits, PMU 0x3c00 software reset) extracted from the pinned open vendor kernel with 47 literal citations and cross-checked against the device's measured runtime DTB; a freestanding replay module with a PMU model, 13 tests and a 27/27 mutation check; a decision-text template. Nothing ran on the phone; no S-Boot disassembly was used.

acceptance.1_vendor_registers: plan.json lists file, line and exact text for every register/offset/value (47 citations at pin 417484173abc2c4fa93e738ea82ad9f2e84911b1); verify_plan.py re-reads them and re-derives 16 of the 17 values from the cited text (pmu_base is checked against the runtime DTB reg); README.md compares vendor, existing loader (recovery_guard.c: INFORM3 read/clear, WDT 83 s, no INFORM2/0x190/0x3c00 writes) and the module; the NAT-004/NAT-011 SWRESET offsets conflict with the vendor 0x3c00 and are recorded as unreconciled and unused.
acceptance.2_patch_design_and_decision_text: module/s5e9945_reset.{h,c} (aarch64 freestanding build clean, dsb sy + wfi) with host model tests; README.md 'Design for the loader' and 'Native test plan'; decision-template.md for the agent-written decision under 0019. U1-U4 (PMU stores effective, SWRESET without ACPM STOP, S-Boot honouring INFORM3 with persistent REBOOT_MODE=4, DOWNLOAD vs BOOTLOADER word) are stated and are measurements of the native run.
acceptance.3_no_sboot_review: No S-Boot disassembly or static review was used; sources are the open vendor kernel, the measured runtime DTB and the measured behaviour of runs 001-009.

established: At the pin, the Android kernel's reboot-to-download path writes INFORM2 byte [23:16]=0x4e, INFORM3=0x12345601, reboot-cmd bits[2:0]=0 and PMU+0x3c00=2 (priority 130 sec_reboot then 128 exynos-reboot, with an ACPM STOP request between); 'download' is unknown to exynos-reboot and handled only by sec_reboot (verifier: 105/105).
The device's own runtime DTB (sha256 95fa811a...46c3) carries the same reboot-offset/trigger/cmd-offset and magic/panic inform offsets and the PMU reg 0x12860000.

The module writes exactly those registers in that order with read-backs, refuses other reasons, never triggers after a failed read-back (13 model tests); 27/27 seeded defects are killed; negative controls for the verifier (tampered line, text, pin, values, absence claims, DTB) fail as they should.
not_established: U1: that the loader's PMU stores take effect. U2: that a software reset works without the ACPM STOP request. U3: that S-Boot honours INFORM3=DOWNLOAD while its persistent REBOOT_MODE=4. U4: DOWNLOAD (0x12345601) vs BOOTLOADER (0x1234560d) word.
That the phone resets, enters Download Mode or returns to Android through this path. Nothing was run on the phone; the PMU model is my reading of the vendor driver.
